questions.question: Which state special schools have the highest number of enrollees from grades 1 through 12?
questions.evidence: State Special Schools refers to fld065 = 31; Grades 1 through 12 means K-12
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld046 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld065 = 31 ORDER BY T1.fld019 DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.School FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.DOC = 31 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Among the schools with an SAT excellence rate of over 0.3, what is the highest eligible free rate for students aged 5-17?
questions.evidence: Excellence rate = fld040 / fld036; Eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 = fld025 / fld024
questions.SQL: SELECT MAX(CAST(T1.fld025 AS REAL) / T1.fld024) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld030 WHERE CAST(T2.fld040 AS REAL) / T2.fld036 > 0.3
questions.SQL_original: SELECT MAX(CAST(T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE CAST(T2.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T2.NumTstTakr > 0.3

questions.question: What is the average number of test takers from Fresno schools that opened between 1/1/1980 and 12/31/1980?
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(T1.fld036) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld030 = T2.fld001 WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.fld060) = '1980' AND T2.fld044 = 'Fresno'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' AND T2.County = 'Fresno'

questions.question: What is the Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) in the school administered by an administrator whose first name is Alusine. List the district code of the school.
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld020 * 100 / T1.fld019, T1.fld004 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld079 = 'Alusine'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`, T1.`District Code` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'

questions.question: Rank schools by their average score in Writing where the score is greater than 499, showing their charter numbers.
questions.evidence: Valid charter number means the number is not null
questions.SQL: SELECT fld063, fld039, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fld039 DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM tab03 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld030 WHERE T2.fld039 > 499 AND NOT fld063 IS NULL
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CharterNum, AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM schools AS T1  INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T2.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND CharterNum is not null
